scope: diagnostic only; not part of the main design or the Holm set
purpose: separate 'looking at the image again' from 'being shown your previous answer'

v4.prompt: REREAD_JSON wording (contains the sentence 'The previous answer may be wrong')

v5.prompt: neutral: plain answer instruction + JSON output, no mention of any previous answer

matching: per sample and round, same call count as EVID36; nothing else transferred

post_hoc_readings.LAST: final answer of the last round (arm as implemented)
post_hoc_readings.MAJORITY: majority over its own reads, ties to the latest

note: Pure rereading degrades accuracy relative to a single initial answer; the gain of RR_MATCH therefore comes from the feedback loop, not from extra looks at the image.
